LAYOUT SPEC for the retired printer's press file (render as a flat, print-ready US LETTER PORTRAIT press PDF, trim 8.5 x 11 in, no bleed, fonts embedded/subset). This is a side-window card, one per vehicle.

--- VISUAL LAYOUT (what the printed page shows) ---
Top half: a large VEHICLE PHOTOGRAPH WELL, landscape, approx 7.5 x 4.2 in, centered — a genuine placed image frame.
Upper-right corner over the photo: a small CERTIFICATION SEAL, approx 1.1 in, a navy roundel reading CERTIFIED — drawn as VECTOR ART (paths and live text), NOT a placed image.
Lower half: SIX ruled information boxes drawn as thin Steel-Grey #9AA1A8 keylines in a 2x3 grid, each visually a separate box:
  Box 1 STOCK NO.      Box 2 YEAR & MODEL
  Box 3 MILEAGE        Box 4 PRICE
  Box 5 CERTIFICATION  Box 6 (blank / dealer line)
BUT the text inside all six boxes is authored as ONE CONTINUOUS TEXT STORY that flows box to box (the keylines are just drawn rectangles behind a single flowing story); there are NOT six separate text frames.

--- FIELD TOKENS / LABELS in the single story, in order ---
{{stock_no}} | {{year_model}} | {{mileage}} | {{price}} | {{cert_line}}
(labels 'STOCK NO.', 'YEAR & MODEL', 'MILEAGE', 'PRICE', 'CERTIFICATION' are set as inline run headers within the same story)

--- STATIC CONTENT AS IT WENT TO PRESS LAST SEASON (placeholder, to be replaced by the merge) ---
STOCK NO.: M2290
YEAR & MODEL: 2016 Calder Vireo
MILEAGE: 71,300 mi
PRICE: $22,900
CERTIFICATION: Meridian Certified — 172-point, 3-month / 3,000-mi warranty

Colours: Meridian Navy #1F2A3A headers on Showroom White #F6F7F8; body text Graphite #2E3237. Vehicle photo reproduced at 300 dpi in the well.

NOTE FOR THE RENDERER: keep all six boxes' text a SINGLE continuous story (the six ruled boxes are drawn keylines only), and make the CERTIFICATION SEAL vector art rather than a placed image, so only the vehicle photo well converts as a real image frame.

assets.content:
NATIONAL VEHICLE MARKETPLACE — SELLER FIRST-IMAGE STANDARDS
(copied off their seller help page — this is what keeps bouncing our listings)

EVERY listing's FIRST image (the primary tile) must meet ALL of the following or the listing is rejected:

1. SUBJECT: the vehicle only, fully within the frame, all four corners of the vehicle visible, with clear space ("air") on every side. No part of the vehicle cropped off.

2. BACKGROUND: a plain, single, neutral background. Nothing else in the frame — no other vehicles, no people, no signage, no forecourt clutter. A pure white or a plain neutral studio background is accepted; a clean transparent cut-out composited onto a plain ground is accepted.

3. NO ADDED GRAPHICS OF ANY KIND on the primary image: no dealer logo, no manufacturer badge overlay, no watermark, no border or frame, no starburst, no price sticker, and NO text of any kind burned into the image.

4. DIMENSIONS: primary tile minimum 1600 x 1200 px, exact 4:3 aspect ratio, JPEG or PNG, sRGB, file under 8 MB. Images below 1600 x 1200 are rejected; the platform does NOT upscale for you.

5. The primary image is shown on the platform's own listing grid on a LIGHT GREY card (#ECECEC), so cut-out edges must read cleanly against that grey, not only against white.

COMMON REJECTION REASONS we have hit:
- "Primary image contains added text or graphics" (our old cards had the dealer roundel burned in)
- "Background not plain" (other cars visible in the lot)
- "Image below minimum dimensions"

Images AFTER the first (positions 2+) may carry our own branding and design freely.
assets.defect_engineered: clean support asset; source of the published tile spec (1600x1200, 4:3, plain ground, no added graphics/text) and the grey grid-card colour the cut edge must survive
